name: Perfect Parasite
source:
In a world overrun by infection, every scrap of food and every bullet matters. Ash scavenges what she can, but she knows safety is an illusion – and each knock at the door could change everything.

[From [url=https://teagan-120.itch.io/perfect-parasite-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个感染泛滥的世界里，每一粒食物和每一颗子弹都很重要。艾什尽其所能地寻找一切，但她知道安全只是一种幻觉——每一次敲门都可能改变一切。

[来自[url=https://teagan-120.itch.io/perfect-parasite-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
